newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - May 19.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - May 19.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Talk was thin in the Singapore bunker market on Monday but prices remained firm in line with strength in the fuel oil cargo market and crude gains, traders said. With a domestic holiday ahead on Wednesday, most traders did not expect major trading interest in the market, which will depend largely on the cargo movements.
